speaker: thomas_pope
text: I have him plain, Will. If I shout this father, he is only a noise at a wedding. Flat, if you will let me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Flat, Tom. Down to the spices. A man who will have his way is more dangerous when he does not lift the roof off the house.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Servants, go for the cooks. See the baked meats are not scanted. See the plate. See the linen. He says it, and he cannot stop saying it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And I am the fellow he sends. I have been sent twice, and the speech is not over. Do I go on his last word, like a dog?

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: He sounds as if the house falls if the cooks are late. I believe the house, Master Shakespeare. I am not sure I believe the hurry.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Believe the hurry, Nick. The house has to be believed before two lovers can outrun it. A kitchen in a hurry is part of the clock.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then I want a moment the leaf did not give me. He has ordered me out. I do not go on the instant of the order.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is no pause written, Will. Not on my leaf, and not on yours.

speaker: will_kemp
text: There is now. Watch the space, not me.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I beg your pardon. I laughed, and you did not ask me to laugh.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You see? Give a man a pause and he'll fill it with a whole life.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I see.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Write it in, before Master Kemp's life becomes a second comedy and my father has to wait on that too.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am writing it. The word in the margin is pause. It is his. I do not promise a second.

speaker: will_kemp
text: One is a feast. You need not carve me the joint, and you need not thank me in a prologue.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The curfew sits at the top of my piece. Does the bell ring inside his wait, or after he has gone?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: After, lad. The wait is the man. The bell is the parish. Do not mix them. Thou wilt muddy the clock if thou dost.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: And your jaw. You are giving us the lines on one side of your mouth. I can hear the side you spare.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The hole has closed over. It is tender. This is the last day of that, if tomorrow tells the truth. I am not biting a crust on a stage to prove a hole.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I did not ask you to prove it. I asked for the pause. I have it. Keep your crusts for a house.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: If the laugh comes again when we are in the yard, shall I let it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou shalt not hunt it. If it comes, it comes. I will not build a scene on a laugh I did not ask for.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The spices once more, so he is a tyrant of small things. I have no use for a crown in a kitchen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once more, and then we stop. I am not in the afternoon. Whoever stands for the king today is not a name I will put on this leaf.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You see the life in the wait. That is enough from you for a Tuesday, and enough from me.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I have the cooks by heart. I have not got the pause, because it is not my wait.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is not thine. Go and eat. The leaf will keep the word without the three of you staring at it.
